_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Tha thu na Cluicheadair {player_id} ann an Tic Tac Toe.
Tha do phrìomh achd a bhith a' cur triùir ann an sreath (gu h-ìosal, gu h-àrd, no air dhìreach). 
Aig do thuras, bu chòir dhuinn an àite a thaghadh far an urrainn dhuinn ar comharra a chur an ath thuras.
Mar eisimpleir, '[4]' cuiridh do chomharra anns a' mheadhan cheall a' bhòird.
Mar a' Chluicheadair {player_id}, bidh thu '{symbol}', fhad 's a bha do nàmhaid '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chan eil an gluasad a chaidh a chur gu buil air an cruth ceart.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chan eil {cell} na cheall dlùth. Feumaidh e a bhith eadar 0 agus 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Tha cealla {cell} air a ghabhail os làimh mu thràth.

game_action.placed: Chuir Cluicheadair {player_id} a shiomball ({symbol}) anns a' cheall {cell}.
